QUIC constants, forward declarations, and a 16-byte aligned range type.

# Purpose
This header file defines common QUIC types and constants used across the QUIC code base. It declares failure sentinel values, the `FD_QUIC_MAX_VERSIONS` limit for version packets, and forward declarations for several QUIC-related structures such as `fd_quic_t`, `fd_quic_conn_t`, and `fd_quic_tls_t`. It also defines `fd_quic_range_t`, a 16-byte aligned range type with `offset_lo` and `offset_hi` fields that describe a half-open interval `[offset_lo, offset_hi)`. The file serves as a shared include for code that needs these basic QUIC declarations without including full type definitions.
